name: 黑魅轻奢礼遇女士香水款
description: 墨黑瓶身金环点缀，花海氛围与礼赠场景一体的高级香氛套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep ink-black #17171C and rose-crimson #8E1F2F mood fields alternating with pearl-white #F5F2EC packshot fields
styleLock.lightingSystem: single soft key with controlled falloff, restrained specular highlights on glass, soft contact shadows, no haze
styleLock.surfaceSystem: polished dark stone slab #26262B and matte pearl board #F5F2EC
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter-spacing
styleLock.presentationRules: bottle always upright and centered-stable, hero angle consistent across packshots, label plate readable
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark premium fragrance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ink-black #17171C, champagne-gold #C9A86A, rose-crimson #8E1F2F and pearl-white #F5F2EC; single soft key light with controlled falloff and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter-spacing; thin-line icons in one gold accent; clean high-end fragrance photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright centered product presentation; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索首屏一眼点击，干净合规展示瓶身轮廓
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle upright and fully visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle stands upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible with the cap and label plate unobstructed. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the bottle. Seamless pearl-white background #F5F2EC. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. No extra whitespace, the silhouette fills the field. 8K, commercial fragrance e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no petals, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored tint on the backdrop, no cut-off cap or base.

shots.intent: 一秒传递黑瓶与花海的浓情氛围，确立主视觉记忆点
shots.camera: upward-tilted view with the camera slightly beneath the bottle shoulder, bottle rising against the petal field
shots.lighting: soft directional key from the upper left, petals lit warmly, bottle rim picking up a restrained champagne highlight
shots.background: dense rose-crimson petals #8E1F2F with deep shadow zones #17171C
shots.props: fresh crimson petals surrounding the bottle base
shots.whitespace: generous negative space at the top 25% over the petals for 「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} set in a dense field of crimson petals. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The camera tilts upward from slightly beneath the bottle shoulder, so the bottle rises monumentally against the petal field. Soft directional key from the upper left, petals glowing rose-crimson #8E1F2F, deep shadows #17171C between petals, one restrained champagne highlight on the bottle rim #C9A86A. Petals crowd the bottle base as the only prop. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space at the top 25% reserved for 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no brand marks on petals, no readable text on the label other than the original, no invented note names or duration claims, no model, no watermark, no garbled characters.

shots.intent: 把香水瓶放进赠礼与晚宴情境，激发自我投射
shots.camera: candid eye-level handheld framing over a dark stone vanity, slight 3/4 on the bottle
shots.lighting: warm low-key ambience, one soft practical light from the right at 3200K, gentle falloff
shots.background: polished dark stone slab #26262B with a soft out-of-focus evening room behind
shots.props: an open gift box with a gold satin ribbon and one folded card, none covering the bottle
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, context is the co-star
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting beside an open gift box with a champagne-gold satin ribbon on a polished dark stone vanity #26262B. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Candid eye-level handheld framing with a slight 3/4 on the bottle, an out-of-focus warm evening room behind. Low-key ambience, one soft practical light from the right at 3200K, soft contact shadow under the bottle. Props: the gift box, ribbon and one folded card, none covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no visible face, hands only at the wrist if any, no text on the card, no watermark, no fake logo, no clutter, no duplicated background objects.

shots.intent: 微距展示瓶盖切割面与做工，证明质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the faceted cap, shallow depth of field with the foreground facets sharp
shots.lighting: skimming light from the upper right raking across the facets, controlled pinpoint highlights
shots.whitespace: minimal, the facet detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the faceted gem-shaped cap. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground facets razor sharp, background defocused. Skimming light from the upper right rakes across the cut facets, controlled pinpoint highlights, no blown speculars. Matte pearl board background #F5F2EC softly blurred. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. No extra whitespace, the facets are the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented material claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props, no duplicated facet pattern in the background.

shots.intent: 侧面特写喷头与金环工艺，消除做工疑虑
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile close-up on the metallic spray head and gold collar, tight crop
shots.lighting: soft directional light from the left, a narrow controlled highlight running down the metal collar
shots.background: deep ink-black #17171C with one soft vignette
shots.whitespace: narrow clean band on the right 20% for 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product}, tight crop on the metallic spray head and gold collar from a clean 90-degree side profile. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft directional light from the left draws one narrow controlled highlight down the metal collar #C9A86A against the deep ink-black field #17171C. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, with a narrow clean band on the right 20% for 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no mist spray effect, no fingers on the actuator, no invented hardware specifications, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no warped metal edges.

shots.intent: 示意点涂部位的使用方法，降低上手门槛
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at a woman's bare wrist and forearm, cropped well below the face
shots.lighting: soft diffused window light from the upper left, natural skin rendering with visible pores
shots.props: {product} held lightly at the frame edge, plus one thin-line positioning marker
shots.whitespace: clean band along the left 25% for 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: Usage demonstration: a hand sprays {product} onto pulse points, shown from a high 45-degree angle looking down at a bare wrist and inner forearm, cropped well below the face so no features show. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft diffused window light from the upper left, natural skin texture with visible pores, no retouching. Soft blush textile background #F4E3E1. The bottle and arm occupy 50-60% of the frame, with a clean band along the left 25% for 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」. Negative: no recognizable face, no tattoo, no jewelry logos, no anatomical diagrams with labels, no invented absorption claims, no watermark, no garbled text.

shots.intent: 铺开多种赠礼与使用场合，让买家对号入座
shots.camera: flat lay, top-down 90-degree overhead, four pastel quadrants with the bottle roundel at center
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: white board #FFFFFF carrying four pastel panels #E5D9A0, #CFE3E5, #D9C2E3, #EFD4D6
shots.props: thin-line occasion tags in each quadrant
shots.whitespace: even margins between quadrants, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid: a flat lay of {product} photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, centered in a circular roundel where four pastel quadrants meet. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Quadrants in sand #E5D9A0, mist blue #CFE3E5, lilac #D9C2E3 and blush #EFD4D6 on a white board #FFFFFF, each with one thin-line occasion tag and one short label 「{callout_4}」 to 「{callout_7}」. Even high-key flat lighting. The product roundel occupies 55-60% overall. Negative: no photos of people in the quadrants, no invented occasion claims, no dense body text, no mismatched icon styles, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以完整礼盒包装交付感降风险，强化送礼价值
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle and closed gift box side by side, both fully visible
shots.lighting: even clean studio light with one soft top fill, precise contact shadows
shots.background: charcoal backdrop #26262B with a faint champagne geometric frame #C9A86A
shots.props: closed gift box with a gold-trimmed edge and a gold satin ribbon
shots.whitespace: generous negative space at the bottom 20% for 「{selling_point_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen: {product} standing beside its closed gift box, straight-on eye-level view, both fully visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even clean studio light with one soft top fill, precise contact shadows on the charcoal backdrop #26262B, a faint champagne geometric frame #C9A86A behind. Props: the gold-trimmed gift box and gold satin ribbon only. The product and box occupy 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space at the bottom 20% for 「{selling_point_3}」 and an empty badge placeholder. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no fake seals with text, no invented volume or shelf-life figures, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled characters on the box.

shots.intent: 回到主视觉氛围收口促单，落到礼赠行动
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle matching the benefit shot, bottle centered among petals
shots.lighting: punchier single key from the upper left, controlled falloff, champagne rim light
shots.background: rose-crimson petal field #8E1F2F deepening to ink-black #17171C at the corners
shots.props: scattered crimson petals and one ribbon curl
shots.whitespace: clean horizontal band at the lower third with an empty CTA button placeholder for 「{callout_8}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product} at a slight 3/4 hero angle, centered on a crimson petal field. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Punchier single key from the upper left with controlled falloff, one champagne rim light #C9A86A tracing the bottle edge, petals #8E1F2F deepening to ink-black #17171C at the corners. Props: scattered petals and one ribbon curl. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with a clean horizontal band at the lower third holding an empty CTA button placeholder for 「{callout_8}」 and 「{callout_9}」. Negative: no invented discounts or countdowns, no readable offer text, no model, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated petals forming patterns.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：p1 玫瑰花海主视觉+墨黑方瓶宝石面瓶盖金环，含手写体品牌字样（已剥离）；p2 礼盒金丝带场景与「法国进口」话术（进口宣称已剥离）；p3 品名XX香水/规格50ML/保质期3年/香用料进口（数值规格一律不写入，换 callout 占位）与高贵/自信/永恒三词块；p4 前中后调具体香调名（桂花佛手柑柑橘/玫瑰紫罗兰/兰花香草，按要求不作事实写入，仅留占位）；p5 香气持续12H大数字（功效数值已剥离换 callout）；p6 金属喷头/钻石切割细节特写；p7-8 灰占位礼盒包装与送礼话术；p9 求婚/宴会/聚会/面试四场合宫格；p10 七点喷雾部位示意，含会员免费二维码贴片（已剥离），人像仅腿部无面容。品类判定：品名「香水」、规格液体、适宜人群女性、香调栏，硬证据确凿，判为美妆彩妆/香氛，与源夹名「洗护」不符故改判。源页自相矛盾：p1 称玫瑰花香调、p2-3 称木质花香调，两种说法均未作为事实写入。已剥离：品牌手写字样、进口宣称、留香时长、容量保质期、具体香调名、会员二维码、原文案原句；人像一律改为手部/腕部特写或无面容构图。产品一律以 {product} 占位。
